_why: Ratchet floors. A gate whose check count can fall silently cannot detect a deleted requirement: stripping four required headings from one pack made validate.py drop 1270->1269 and sloplint.py 224->223, both still green. Each number is the count measured on the commit named below. Raise freely; lowering one needs a reason in the same commit.
_raised: validate_palette.py 958 -> 993: validate_status_on_field() checks every semantic colour against the field of its own theme, which nothing did before -- validate_theme() computed one contrast, ink against field, and went straight to peer separation. On its first run it found 28 findings in 11 of 17 packs, and the worst was mechanical: scoreboard's [data-surface="panel"] block remapped eleven tokens and not the status set, so var(--good) painted 3.69:1 on the dark band while --good-on-dark had 10.21 three lines away. Two plants, one per tier. validate.py and sloplint.py are unchanged at 2066 and 450. validate.py 2066 -> 2067: SURFACE_COMPOSITION.md documents the new role marker, which adds one relative-link check.
